summary: Cooper, a 6-year-old neutered male Labrador Retriever, is on day 46 of 56 of a Royal Canin HP trial, and chicken was logged on 29 of 154 meals and treats, with at least 4 off-list feedings, the last on Jun 27. Itching was entered on 16 of 43 logged days over at least 35 days, and this is not a test of the diet: Apoquel (doses not logged), NexGard from Jun 5 and Dentastix from Jun 8 overlap the trial. Dentastix, whose label lists chicken, is on the owner-entered allowed list and was fed daily from Jun 8, and no chicken-free day is recorded since Jun 8; NexGard on Jun 5 and Jul 2 has flavour protein unknown and is not counted off-list. The owner wrote on Jun 18 “flare after the chicken on Sunday”, Sunday being Jun 14; this is not tested, and chicken was fed daily from Jun 8. Whether Apoquel was given, and the itch severity or body site, are unknown.
